Ended, paused or gone quiet 93
  • 100 Grand Bicycle Tour · MIDormant: Rapid Wheelmen stated ‘no 100 Grand for 2025, look for it to return in 2026’, but no 2026 registration or listing was found (last BikeReg edition 2023).
  • ACT Ride / AIDS Ride Wisconsin (Madison, WI)Discontinued. The Wisconsin AIDS Ride Strava club states ‘Vivent Health has discontinued support of our ride in reorganizing its fundraising efforts’; former riders pivoted to Minnesota’s Red Ribbon Ride in 2022 and to social rides. Not on Vivent Health’s 2026-27 events calendar. Last editions were the ARCW/Vivent ‘ACT’ rides (ACT 12 was the last found).
  • AIDS/LifeCycleEnded after the 2025 ride. Announced Sept 11, 2024 by SFAF and the LA LGBT Center (skyrocketing production costs, declining post-pandemic fundraising). Final 7-day, 545-mile SF-to-LA ride concluded June 7, 2025 (arrival ceremonies through June 8) and raised a record ~$17.85M; lifetime $349M+. Successor events: Cycle to Zero (SFAF, May 21-23, 2027) and Center Ride Out (LA LGBT Center, April 23-25, 2027).
  • Amgen Tour of California · CAPro stage race last held in 2019; never resumed (it was a race, not a participation event).
  • Belgian Waffle Ride Kansas (Lawrence) · KSNot part of BWR’s series since 2023; BWR’s 2026 Quad-Tripel Crown is Arizona, California, Utah, Montana (the organizer’s old ‘/pages/kansas’ URL now hosts the Montana event).
  • Belgian Waffle Ride North Carolina (Asheville / Hendersonville) · NCLast held Oct 3-4, 2025 (Wag Valley Farm). BWR’s own future-dates page lists no North Carolina edition for 2026 or 2027. Treat as dropped or on hiatus unless BWR announces a return.
  • Best Buddies Challenge: Hearst Castle · CANot on the Best Buddies Challenge 2026–27 schedule (site lists Hyannis Port, Aspen, NY, Miami, Malibu Camp). Last held Sept 2025; status unclear.
  • Bicycle Tour of Colorado · CONo editions found in recent years; reportedly ceased around 2019-2020.
  • Big Mac Shoreline Scenic Bike Tour / Mackinac Bridge bicycle crossing · MIApparently discontinued: the Mackinac Bridge Authority no longer permits cycling events on the bridge; the Chamber’s spring/fall shoreline tours were last documented in 2018 (Mackinac Island substituted for bridge crossing). No 2025-2026 editions found.
  • Bike Psychos Century · ILApparently dormant: official site last shows the 2017 edition, last third-party listing is the 37th edition (Aug 16, 2020); not on 2026 Chicago-area invitational calendars.
  • Bike the Bluff (Show Low) · AZLast held June 19, 2021 (BlueWolf Events). Dormant/defunct.
  • BikeMaine · MEBicycle Coalition of Maine reportedly ended BikeMaine after the 2023 edition.
  • Bridge to Bridge Incredible Challenge (Lenoir, NC) · NCCentury from Lenoir to Grandfather Mountain; no recent edition found — only historic pages (1990s-2012 listings). Appears discontinued (Lenoir now hosts a ‘Lenoir Bicycle Festival’).
  • Cherry-Roubaix (Traverse City road race/gran fondo) · MINo 2025 or 2026 edition; the last gran fondo was the Crystal Mountain Cherry Roubaix Gran Fondo (June 4, 2022, Benzie Sunrise Rotary). It was also a USA Cycling/MBRA-sanctioned road race series.
  • Co2UT (Colorado-to-Utah gravel) · CONo edition listed after May 14, 2023 on Gravel Calendar’s Colorado page (Fruita now hosts ‘Desert Gravel’, Apr 25, 2026, a different event). Likely discontinued.
  • Colorado Classic · CODefunct. UCI women’s stage race last held Aug 2019 (men’s race dropped after 2018); 2020 edition cancelled and organizer RPM Events Group did not bring it back.
  • ConnectiCare Gran Fondo (Madison/New Haven, CT) · CTOnly legacy content found (2020 registration language, undated pricing) on the New Haven Grand Prix site; no 2024-2026 edition found. Appears dormant.
  • Cycle Greater Yellowstone · MTDormant: the Greater Yellowstone Coalition’s supported multi-day tour through Montana, Wyoming and Idaho gateway towns has no editions after 2019 (Red Lodge, MT), and no 2026 or 2027 edition is announced.
  • Cycle Greater Yellowstone (Montana/Wyoming) · MTReported ended after the 2018 edition.
  • Cycle Oregon Classic (week-long ride) · ORCycle Oregon announced in May 2023 that the 2023 Classic (Sept 9-16, 2023, ‘Wine. Waves. Wonderland.’) would be the last, citing production costs, rider preferences, volunteer capacity, fire seasons and ridership at half of peak. The organization continues with Rally, Gravel and Joyride.
  • Dirty Kanza (name) · KSNot defunct as an event — renamed UNBOUND Gravel in 2020; see the UNBOUND entry.
  • El Tour de Mesa · AZPerimeter Bicycling’s page states: ‘We had a great ride in Mesa but decided not to continue this ride.’ Last edition was the 30th (April 2, 2022).
  • Elephant Rock Ride (Subaru Elephant Rock Cycling Festival) · COPERMANENTLY DISCONTINUED after the 2022 edition (final ride June 5, 2022). Event director Scott Olmsted concluded the ride because of Castle Rock’s rapid growth, increased traffic and ongoing construction - the town grew from about 10,000 residents in 1987, when Scot Harris founded the ride, to over 80,000. The ride was not relocated. At its peak it offered routes from 7 to 105 miles and could accommodate up to 7,000 riders, serving as Colorado’s traditional season-opening cycling festival. A separate ‘Sunrise to Sunset Elephant Rock’ 12-hour MOUNTAIN BIKE endurance race is run by The Ride Collective at Philip S. Miller Park in Castle Rock (listed for May 29, 2027) - that is an off-road event and not a continuation of the road ride.
  • Empire State AIDS Ride (NY)No edition is known since 2019.
  • Epic Rides Carson City Off-Road · NVSame as Grand Junction Off-Road: paused by Epic Rides after 2023 and absent from the organizer’s current event list; no 2024–2027 editions found.
  • Epic Rides Grand Junction Off-Road · COEpic Rides paused Grand Junction and Carson City after 2023 (organizer announcement); no 2024–2027 editions found.
  • Eroica California / Nova Eroica California (Cambria) · CAReplaced in 2026 by the Central Coast Classico, whose site says it ‘replaces the beloved annual event Eroica California’. GranFondoGuide’s ‘Sept 13, 2026’ Eroica listing is stale.
  • Farm to Fork Fondo – Shenandoah (Middletown, VA) · VAThis stop of the Farm to Fork series was last held Oct 23-24, 2021 (Belle Grove); the 2026 Farm to Fork calendar lists only Champlain Islands VT and Amish Country PA.
  • Four Star Bike Tour / Four Star Bike & Chow · ILNo longer held. Active Transportation Alliance’s events page lists only Bike the Drive; the last references to Four Star Bike & Chow are from the mid-2010s.
  • Golden Gran Fondo · CODEFUNCT. Billed as one of the toughest one-day gran fondos in America when it launched (inaugural edition June 23), the Golden Gran Fondo was a round of the Gran Fondo National Series. The most recent edition traceable online is 2022 (granfondonationalseries.com/gran-fondo-golden-2022), and the Gran Fondo National Series itself has wound down. No 2026 or 2027 edition is scheduled.
  • GRABAAWR - Great Annual Bicycle Adventure Along the Wisconsin River · WIBike Wisconsin’s GRABAAWR reportedly not held since about 2019-2020 (SAGBRAW and Bike Northwoods continued).
  • Gran Fondo Hincapie – Fort Worth · TXHeld March 30, 2019 (15/50/80 mi); no later edition. Hincapie’s current event list (Merced, Chattanooga, Lehigh Valley, Greenville) does not include Fort Worth or Bentonville.
  • Gran Fondo NJ / Garden State Fondo (Morristown) · NJLast held Sept 2019 (Morristown; GF Guide’s #1 US gran fondo that year). Founder Marty Epstein died May 2019; event postponed in 2020 and again in 2021 (Morristown Green, Aug 2021); a Sept 11, 2022 date was advertised on Gran Fondo Guide but no evidence of any edition since, and granfondonj.com is stale (2013-era content). The Highlands Gran Fondo (Butler, NJ) is the current GFNS event in the state.
  • Harbor to the Bay · MAEnded — the 21st ride on Sept 23, 2023 was announced as the final Harbor to the Bay (Club Café continues its nonprofit work through other events).
  • Harlem Valley Rail Ride · NYLast held 2019; the 2020 edition (Aug 30, 2020) was cancelled for COVID-19 and no later edition was found. The official domain harlemvalleyrailride.com now serves unrelated content; partner pages (Gotham Bicycle Tours, Unlimited Biking) still show 2020.
  • Harvest Century · ORCANCELLED and the organizer has shut down. ORbike’s event page states ‘THE 2026 EVENT IS CANCELLED’ and ‘ORbike is closing.’ Owner Brad Nelson announced ORbike is closing after ~20 years, saying the business ‘hasn’t turned a profit since 2023,’ and registered riders were refunded/notified by email. No successor organizer has been announced, so no 2027 Harvest Century is expected unless someone revives it.
  • Haute Route Rockies · CODEFUNCT. The Mavic Haute Route Rockies, a multi-day timed amateur stage event that ran in Colorado from 2017, ended when Haute Route announced in December 2019 that it was cancelling its events and pulling out of the USA, ending its American expansion. No edition has run since 2019 and none is scheduled for 2027.
  • Hell’s Gate Hundred (AdventureCORPS Death Valley century) · CAAdventureCORPS site: held annually in March 2009-2012 only. The Planet Ultra Death Valley Century (November) is the surviving event.
  • High Pass Challenge · WACascade Bicycle Club’s long-running 114-mile Mount St. Helens challenge ride (Randle to Windy Ridge) no longer appears in Cascade’s event lineup. It is absent from both the published 2026 season schedule and Cascade’s December 2025 ‘save the date’ announcement of 2026 rides and tours, and the most recent editions traceable online date to 2019 with subsequent cancellations. Treated as discontinued; no 2027 edition expected.
  • Hub On Wheels (Boston) · MABoston’s citywide car-free Storrow Drive ride; the most recent edition found is 2019 (Greenovate Boston page dated Oct 28, 2019); no 2020-2026 editions found and the Landry’s page carries no current date. Treat as dormant/defunct.
  • Iowa’s Ride · IADefunct: the RAGBRAI-rival ride founded by T.J. Juskiewicz was downsized to a weekend in Eldora (2021) after its director left for Arizona; no editions since.
  • L.A.T.E. Ride (Chicago night ride) · ILDiscontinued. Friends of the Parks announced in December 2016 that the ride would not continue; its site now labels it the ‘Former L.A.T.E. Ride’.
  • Land Run 100 (name) · OKNot defunct as an event — renamed The Mid South; see The Mid South entry.
  • Longhorn 500 · TXPAUSED for 2027 by the RAAM organization (Aug 2026 announcement). 500-mile RAAM qualifier in the Texas Hill Country (2025 edition Mar 23-25, 2025).
  • Mankato River Ramble · MNReplaced in 2025 by the Kato Bike Fall Fest (Greater Mankato Bike & Walk Advocates + BikeMN), which is listed in events.
  • Minnesota Ironman Bike Ride / The Freebike · MNRebranded as ‘The Freebike’ by Free Bikes 4 Kidz MN; the ride was paused in 2025 ‘to focus on the mission’ and no 2026 edition was found. Status: hiatus/unresolved.
  • Mt. Hood Cycling Classic · ORDefunct/inactive: no edition since 2019. Treat it as not running unless the organizer announces a revival.
  • Mt. Tam Double Century (Marin Cyclists) · CANo longer offered: the Marin Century’s current route list tops out at the 127-mile Double Metric (37/64/94/102/127 mi); the 200-mile Mt. Tam Double no longer appears and the club’s Mt Tam Double page returns 404.
  • North Star Grand Prix (formerly Nature Valley Grand Prix) · MNDefunct. Last held 2019; the 2020 edition was cancelled and the event was discontinued.
  • Padres Pedal the Cause (San Diego)Rebranded/replaced: ‘Padres Pedal the Cause will expand and become the Curebound Cancer Challenge’ (UC San Diego; Aug 1, 2026; Aug 7, 2027). Listed under its new name in events.
  • Paso Robles Cycling Festival / Great Western Bicycle Rally · CAPossibly defunct: the last known edition was 2019 and no 2025 or 2026 edition has been listed.
  • Pedal Pennsylvania · PALong-defunct week-long tour (ended in the 2010s).
  • Pedal the Plains · CODORMANT / APPARENTLY DEFUNCT. The Denver Post Pedal The Plains Bicycle Tour, a three-day eastern-Colorado tour that also offered a century ride and a family fun ride, has no recent editions: its official site (pedaltheplains.com) still displays 2015 ‘fourth edition’ content with no dates for any subsequent year. It shared the Denver Post event portfolio with Ride the Rockies, which was itself cancelled in 2024. No 2026 or 2027 edition is announced.
  • Pedal the Plains (Colorado) · CODenver Post-era eastern-plains tour; reportedly not held since 2019.
  • Philadelphia International Cycling Classic (Philly Cycling Classic) · PADefunct. The Manayunk Wall classic was last held in 2016; no edition since.
  • Race Across America (RAAM) · CAPAUSED (announced Aug 2026): the RAAM organization paused all 2027 events — RAAM, RAW, RAE, Longhorn 500, Stampede 200 — and The 508 for 2026 and 2027, pending a strategic review; no return date given.
  • Race Across the East (RAE)PAUSED for 2027 (listed among the RAAM organization’s paused 2027 events).
  • Race Across the West (RAW) · CAPAUSED (announced Aug 2026): the RAAM organization paused all 2027 events — RAAM, RAW, RAE, Longhorn 500, Stampede 200 — and The 508 for 2026 and 2027, pending a strategic review; no return date given.
  • RAMROD (Ride Around Mount Rainier in One Day) · WAON HOLD / PAUSED, not confirmed for 2027. The Redmond Cycling Club cancelled the 2026 edition after Mount Rainier National Park refused to permit the route through the Stevens Canyon corridor. The park offered only a Skate Creek reroute outside the signature corridor or a post-Labor Day September date, both of which the club rejected as unworkable (short daylight and cold for a 150-mile, ~10,000 ft day). The club calls it ‘a pause rather than a conclusion’ and says it remains committed to future opportunities ‘including the possibility of returning in 2027,’ but no 2027 event or lottery has been announced as of Sept 2026. Historically a ~150-mile, 10,000 ft ride with entry by lottery.
  • Rasputitsa · VTOrganizers said on Jul 16, 2026 they are ‘not organizing or accepting registrations for a 2026/2027 race’; no 2026 edition was held after co-founder Anthony Moccia died on Mar 13, 2026. 2027 dates seen on listing sites are placeholders.
  • Real Ale Ride (Blanco, TX) · TXNot listed on the wheelbrothers.com Texas ride calendars for 2025 or 2026; appears discontinued.
  • Red Ribbon Ride · MNDormant: the last edition was Aug 2023 (two days, Willow River, MN); no 2024-2026 edition, and its TeamRaiser page is gone. Check with The Aliveness Project before planning around it.
  • Ride 2 SurviveCanadian event (Kelowna to Delta, BC) - outside US scope, not defunct.
  • Ride Around Washington (RAW) - Cascade Bicycle Club · WACascade’s week-long Ride Around Washington has not been offered in recent years; its 2026 multi-day offering is the 3-day Lake Chelan Tour.
  • Ride for Kids (Pediatric Brain Tumor Foundation)Motorcycle rides, not bicycle events - out of scope.
  • Ride for Life Chicago (formerly Ride for AIDS Chicago) - TPANLikely discontinued. tpan.com/rideforlife now redirects to Vivent Health’s Chicago page (TPAN joined Vivent Health), and Vivent Health’s 2026-27 events calendar lists no Chicago ride. Treat as ended unless Vivent Health says otherwise.
  • Ride Idaho · IDOn hiatus: Biking Bis reported Ride Idaho ‘still on hiatus in 2023’ and rideidaho.org still shows an old route/pricing ($895, 7 days, 370 miles, Ketchum to Idaho Falls) with no 2024-2027 dates. Treat as inactive unless the organizer announces a return.
  • Ride the Rockies (Colorado) · COCanceled in April 2024 for the June 2024 edition due to ‘limited registration’ by owner Ventures Endurance (which acquired it from the Denver Post Community Foundation after 37 years); not held in 2025 or 2026 - a June 2026 Colorado Sun story refers to it as ‘the canceled Ride the Rockies’. Colorado’s Ride (coloradosride.com) is the de facto successor. Granfondoguide’s ‘June 6-12, 2027’ listing is an auto-generated unconfirmed placeholder, not an announcement.
  • Ride the Rockies (The Denver Post Ride The Rockies) · COCANCELLED AND NOT REVIVED. The 2024 edition was cancelled because of insufficient registration - organizers said ‘After much consideration and evaluation of the limited registration, we regret that Ride The Rockies 2024 is canceled’ - making 2023 the last completed edition after 37 consecutive years (excluding 2020, lost to the pandemic). Organizers said they were ‘assessing the best options for this beloved ride,’ but no edition has run since and none is announced for 2027. A separate multi-day event, Colorado’s Ride, has emerged in its place (Aug 9-14, 2026, Crested Butte).
  • Ride to Montauk · NYOrganizer states the 2025 edition was ‘the LAST Ride to Montauk, at least for the foreseeable future’ (possible reunion mooted for 2034). Offered 25-155 mile routes from Manhattan/Brooklyn/Long Island to Montauk; benefited God’s Love We Deliver.
  • Rooted Vermont · VTPaused in 2023 and never returned; no 2024–2026 editions and no presence on current Vermont gravel calendars.
  • Skull Valley Loop Challenge (Prescott) · AZSuspended by Prescott Alternative Transportation in 2022 following a 2021 fatal crash and volunteer/resource limits; no editions since and no 2026/2027 dates.
  • SMART Ride (Miami to Key West, FL)The 20th SMART Ride in November 2023 was announced as its last (Watermark Out News, Sept 18, 2023; OutClique ‘The Smart Ride Announces the End of the Ride After 20 Years’). Homepage now reads ‘Thank You for 20 Years of changing lives’. 2-day, 165-mile Miami-to-Key West ride that returned 100% of funds to Florida AIDS service organizations.
  • SpokeFest · WAThe SpokeFest organization formally DISSOLVED in January 2023. The ride was cancelled in 2020 and 2021 for COVID and again in 2022 after key leadership departed, and the nonprofit then wound up, transferring its remaining funds to the Spokane Parks Foundation to support Summer Parkways (an open-streets block party) instead. No SpokeFest ride is planned for 2027.
  • Stampede 200 · TXPAUSED for 2027 by the RAAM organization (Aug 2026 announcement).
  • Terrible Two Double Century · CAOn hiatus: Sonoma County’s SRCC says the Terrible Two ‘will not be held in 2026’ and is recruiting volunteers for a possible 2027 return; no 2027 date or registration is posted.
  • The 508 (Silver State 508, formerly Furnace Creek 508) · NVPAUSED (announced Aug 2026): the RAAM organization paused all 2027 events — RAAM, RAW, RAE, Longhorn 500, Stampede 200 — and The 508 for 2026 and 2027, pending a strategic review; no return date given.
  • The Ride to Conquer Cancer - US editions (Seattle, Washington DC/Baltimore, Philadelphia, Boston)No current US edition found; only old nonprofit directory entries (Idealist) surfaced and the brand is active only in Canada (Princess Margaret, PMCF Ride North) and Australia. US editions ended in the mid-2010s (Seattle’s successor is Obliteride).
  • TOSRV West (Tour of the Swan River Valley) · MTDEFUNCT. Montana’s long-running two-day double century, run by the Missoula Bicycle Club from Missoula through the Swan River Valley, reached its 45th annual edition and then lapsed; no recent editions are traceable and no 2026 or 2027 date exists. The Missoula Bicycle Club itself is dissolving - its own event calendar states the club ‘will stop after 9/30/2026’ and a members’ meeting on 9/24/2026 at Silver Park was called to discuss a dissolution plan, which forecloses a club-run revival.
  • Tour de Bier KC (as a non-charity ride) · MONot defunct but re-scoped: BikeWalkKC handed the ride to the Head for the Cure Foundation; it is now a brain-cancer fundraiser (June 7, 2026 edition), so it falls under the charity-ride category.
  • Tour de Fat (Minneapolis stop) · MNNew Belgium’s Tour de Fat no longer tours the Midwest; 2026 schedule lists only Fort Collins CO (Aug 29) and Asheville NC (Oct 3).
  • Tour de Georgia (pro stage race) · GAProfessional stage race last held 2008 — defunct. Not to be confused with the active Tour of Georgia Gran Fondo (Helen, GA; April 25, 2027).
  • Tour de Kota · SDDefunct: the Argus Leader’s multi-day Tour de Kota ended (last held c. 2015); South Dakota’s cross-state ride is now RASDak (multi-day, out of scope).
  • Tour de Kota (South Dakota) · SDReported discontinued after the 2015 edition; South Dakota’s cross-state ride is now RASDak.
  • Tour de Shawnee (Illinois) · ILNo editions found after 2015; byway page shows ‘Date: TBD’ and was last updated Nov 2015.
  • Tour de Shawnee (Kansas) · KSShawnee Parks & Recreation cancelled the (34th) 2026 edition due to lower-than-anticipated registration; no future date announced.
  • Tour de Troit · MIOn hiatus/unresolved: organizers cancelled the 2025 ride (Sept 13, 2025) citing rising event costs, refunded 1,300+ riders and said they would work with the city to bring it back; no 2026 edition was found as of Sept 2026.
  • Tour of Anchorage · AKNot a cycling event - it is the March Nordic ski marathon; no organized road-cycling event by this name was found.
  • Tour of Utah · UTDefunct. UCI 2.Pro stage race last held Aug 2019; 2020 and 2021 editions cancelled and the race was never revived.
  • Tour of Utah / original Ultimate Challenge · UTThe Larry H. Miller Tour of Utah pro race was last held in 2019 and cancelled permanently; its Ultimate Challenge fondo ended with it. A revived ‘Ultimate Challenge’ ride was run by Salt Lake Criterium on Aug 15, 2026 (see events).
  • Venus de Miles · CODORMANT / APPARENTLY DISCONTINUED. Colorado’s flagship all-women’s road ride, running since 2008 with 30, 48 and 64-mile courses plus a finish festival, was last held on Aug 24, 2024. Event listings now show the ride as ‘TBD or cancelled’ with no confirmed future dates, and no 2026 or 2027 edition has been announced.
  • Winston-Salem Cycling Classic · NCInactive: the UCI road race and criterium have not been held since 2023, and no 2026 or 2027 edition is announced.
  • Worst Day of the Year Ride · ORON HOLD / likely ended. The long-running late-winter costume ride was cancelled in 2025 (it had been scheduled for March 23) because of a sustained decline in ridership - from a peak of roughly 2,500 riders in the early-to-mid 2000s down to about 600 - plus rising operating costs. Lucky Labrador Brew Pub owner Gary Geist said organizer Axiom Event Productions would assess whether to hold it ‘on a year-to-year basis.’ It has not returned, and its former promoter ORbike announced in 2026 that it is closing. No 2027 edition is announced.

Dates marked ✓ are published by the organizer. Dates marked ~ are placed on the same weekend as the 2026 edition; the date note under each event says how. TBA means the event exists but has not put out a 2026 or 2027 date. US only, plus the one ride outside the US Robert is doing; virtual-only and indoor-only events are left out.

Updated October 21, 2026. Compiled Sept 15–16, 2026 from organizer sites, BikeReg, USA Cycling, Life Time, the National MS Society, the ADA and GranFondoGuide; per-event URLs in sources. Confirm with the organizer before booking travel. JSON feed.
